verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is admins being able to wipe a user's account from a mobile device and list deleted users through the Directory API. These are tangential to controlling how long data is kept and when it is deleted. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies/rules, data deletion schedules, controls over retention of AI/Gemini or Meet note data, eDiscovery/hold documentation, and any independent corroboration.
